name: TensoRF
definition: A factorized tensorial radiance field that represents continuous volume density ($σ$) and view-dependent color ($c$) using tensor factorization (CP or VM) to achieve compact modeling and fast reconstruction.
summary: TensoRF is a compact volume rendering method that factorizes radiance fields into low-rank tensor components to solve memory bottlenecks, unlike MLP-based NeRFs or static Plenoxels.
